about: The family registry: one entry per family revision (FAM-09). Maintained by hand. The oracle does not write this file.

vectors_blake3 is the BLAKE3 of the canonical JSON of the array of the revision's cases in the vectors file. Any change to those cases fails the pin. A change to the generated bytes needs a new revision (FAM-08). A change to name or evidence needs a reviewed re-pin and no new revision.
Status is a registry property. The Status item of each contract must equal the entry status.
